turns.content: For the Cope rearrangement of (1S,4R)-2-vinyl-2-azabicyclo[2.2.1]hept-5-ene, identify the contiguous six-atom array using labels C1, C2, N, C4, C5, and C6.
State a procedure for locating the alternating pi-sigma-pi array and its central sigma bond in that bicyclic connectivity.
Apply the procedure to give the ordered rearranging fragment.
Which internal sigma bond breaks in the [3,3]-sigmatropic step?
Which terminal sigma bond forms, and where do the two pi bonds shift?
Map those changes onto the fused-ring locants and identify the product by its systematic name.
Verify the assignment by tracing the broken bond, new bond, and both shifted pi bonds.
Report the product and the concise six-atom mapping.
